title: App identity verification got stricter
summary:
A quiet maintenance day: tighter app identity checks and fresher maps of the growing community garden.

BYOP authentication now verifies app identity through client IDs rather than redirect URLs, while API key metadata is protected from unauthorized changes. Attribution for developers is more dependable, and a quiet metadata escalation path is closed.

Automated updates refreshed app metrics, health checks, greenhouse statistics, README news, and recent community apps. The directory remains a reasonably current map of what people are building.
